title: Safety of Seafood Imports Following Release of Treated Wastewater from Fukushima Nuclear Plant
what_it_is: Safety of Seafood Imports Following Release of Treated Wastewater from Fukushima Nuclear Plant

sections.label: SFA NEA science-based risk assessment
sections.summary: SFA and NEA use a science-based approach to assess food safety risks and environmental impacts respectively.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: The Singapore Food Agency (SFA) and the National Environment Agency (NEA) adopt a science-based approach towards assessing food safety risks and environmental impacts respectively.

sections.label: Monitoring Japan food and seawater
sections.summary: SFA's food import surveillance results are satisfactory, and NEA assesses Japan's treated radioactive water discharge is unlikely to impact Singapore seawater quality.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: SFA has been closely monitoring food imports, including those from Japan, and our surveillance results have been satisfactory.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: NEA assesses that Japan's planned discharge of treated radioactive water from the Fukushima nuclear plant into the sea is unlikely to impact the seawater quality in or around Singapore waters.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: The radioactivity measured continues to remain within our natural background levels.

sections.label: Assessing Japan discharge plan and IAEA
sections.summary: Singapore assesses Japan's discharge plan, watches IAEA monitoring and lab reports, and takes food samples to keep food safe.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: Having said that, we do assess the plan that has been put up by the Japanese authorities on how they intend to discharge the wastewater.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: We do watch what IAEA is doing because IAEA is obviously monitoring the discharge and also on the lab reports very closely.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: More importantly is that we do take food samples to manage the risks.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: So, I can assure the Member as well members of the public that this item is on our agenda and we will be taking all necessary actions to keep food coming into Singapore safe.
